# BigCollatz Research State

- **Final objective:** find a nontrivial cycle of the positive unaccelerated Collatz map with exact repeated-state detection on every generated state.
- **Latest completed full experiment:** `e004-s3-recursive-weighted-lineages-256`.
- **Current best trajectory:** length 27,707 from E004 start ``.
- **Repeated state found:** no exact repeated state has been detected in any current full experiment or valid pilot, including adaptive pilots P007 and P008.
- **Valid tested strategies:** S0 baseline (E001); S1 256-prefix global-top lineage search (E002); S2 weighted E002 lineages (E003); S3 recursive weighted E003 lineages (E004); S4 mixed 128/256/384 global-top prefixes (P003 pilot only); S1 384-prefix pilot (P002); S1 128-prefix pilot (P004); S5 decimal-suffix top10 (P005 pilot only); S6 residue-class top10 (P006 pilot only); adaptive cross-family S1/S5/S6 cells with real recurrence metrics and deterministic allocation (P007/P008 pilots only).
- **Rejected or inconclusive hypotheses:** S1 384-prefix global-top pilot rejected for full scale; S4 mixed-prefix pilot inconclusive/weak for full promotion; S1 128-prefix pilot rejected; isolated S5 and S6 pilots inconclusive; adaptive Stage B did not justify full promotion because it did not beat E004 and did not show repeatable record-scale evidence.
- **Strongest observed signals:** recursive 256-prefix lineage weighting remains the best full-scale evidence and produced the 27,707 global maximum; adaptive P007/P008 showed parity-prefix robustness by score/top-tail, while suffix can still produce isolated high candidates.
- **Active hypothesis:** adaptive cells may become useful if diversified over more source parents and calibrated against robust tail metrics rather than single maxima.
- **Immediate next action:** refine the adaptive cell set with parent-rank diversity and rerun a compact isolated pilot before considering any 10,000-candidate full experiment.
- **Stopping reason for this task:** correctness implementation and acceptance checks completed, deterministic Stage A and Stage B pilots completed, no nontrivial cycle was found, and evidence was insufficient for full experiment promotion.
